text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hum-hum-hum~♪
choice_data_list: You're in a good mood. Did something happen?
You're in a good mood, huh? Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Actually, after this,
I'm going to hear out Biko-san and
Akebono-san's 'favors'!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The day has finally come where
my juniors rely on me, hasn't it...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Then... just like Maruzen-san,
always calm no matter what she's asked,
and casually giving great advice...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I have to show them a cool, composed reaction!
Chiyono O-san! Thanks for waiting~♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! You coming along too, Trainer?!
Nice, the more the merrier!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sensing a discrepancy with Sakura Chiyono O's claim that she was being relied upon,
I decided to accompany her, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: A-An amusement park...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yeah! The two of us were just saying how much fun it'd be to come with you, Chiyono O-san~♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
So *that's* what they meant by 'favors'...
B-But still! They're definitely relying on me...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Right? No, definitely!
In that case—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me! I'll make sure our outing is the absolute most fun ever!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"The Carrotman show was the best~!
That final Carrot Punch at the end was so on point too!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I see... All right!
They're holding a photoshoot over there, so let's go!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Say chee—ah!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Carrotman-san!
I believe the angle of your punching arm
is shallower than before!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Since this is your absolute favorite pose, Biko-san,
I really want to get the shot just right!
Ah! Please keep looking this way!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(Alright! I gave instructions just like
a professional photographer! Now Biko-san
will have a wonderful memory to look back on...!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wait, ah!?
Biko-san, don't put your arms down!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Nah, there's a line forming, so let's do it later!
Knowing when to step back is important for an ally of justice.
Right, Carrotman!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah-wa-wa!? You're right! I-I'm so sorry... for causing trouble...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
L-Leave it to me this time for sure!
If I recall correctly, Akebono-san loves
huge dishes, right?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I looked it up earlier, and apparently this amusement park
is famous for its extra-large omelet!
Let's order one!

text_block_list.name: Cafe Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, valued customer... regarding the extra-large omelet,
it requires a reservation made by the day before...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
A normal omelet is totally fine too~♪
Anything tastes delicious when we eat it together!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: (Hauuu~~! I did it again!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Contrary to Sakura Chiyono O's hopes,
failure after failure kept piling up—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for today, Chiyono O and everyone!
I had so much fun~♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Let's play again sometime!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah... See you later!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*
I was completely useless, wasn't I...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"I was supposed to show them how dependable I am as a senior,
but I just ended up spinning my wheels the whole time.
...In fact, they even had to cover for me..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Even though the two of them relied on me...
choice_data_list: I think both of you enjoyed yourselves.
Things don't always go smoothly right from the start.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: That may be true, but... if that's the case, then I don't really even need to be here...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! No, no!
Don't be so negative, Chiyono O!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Times like this call for pure hard work! As they say, "A carrot in the rough becomes a diamond!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes! It's a proverb that means: "If you never give up and keep polishing it, even a carrot can shine like a diamond!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'll shine brightly just like a carrot too!
Watch me, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Setting that proverb aside, the incident left me
wondering how she planned to push forward from here.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Right! There's no way it'd go smoothly right from the start!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: All I have to do is let people rely on me more and more, and get better at it as I go!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Mmmghhh!
I can feel the motivation welling up inside me!
I'm gonna do my best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was an incident that left me wondering
how she intended to do her best from here on out.
